what: What the design site's Vehicles review page shows for this car (R126). tools/vehicles/review/build.mjs turns this, vehicle.json, the bake and assets/profiles/<id>.json into art/ui/poc/vehicles/<id>/; tools/vehicles/review/check.mjs fails if any Vehicles-contract item is missing. Paths are repo-relative.
name: Cruz Missile
summary: Owner panel follow-up: fuller door waist and tucked sill, curved nudge rails with brackets penetrating the actual fascia, thick conforming splitter and closed atlas wheels. Independent level undertray and inner well walls remove the arch-to-centre floor fans. Hawk-style wheel detail saves 96 LOD0 triangles and funds the repaired volume. Intact triangles 2052 / 897 / 590, within unchanged 2800 / 900 / 600. Collider/sidecar/profile bytes and hinges are unchanged. Shaded comparisons inspected; generated-reference lighting and fine accessories remain approximate, not an owner likeness acceptance.
feedback: Comment on this page (what to change, which view or state); the session turns each comment into a bug bead that cites this page and the car's id.

reference.note: Fixed-world-camera previous/current body, side, front and underside board: docs/evidence/P1-V-cruz-panels/visual-comparison.png. No per-model resizing in that board. shadedComparison.caption: Shaded reference, previous and revised geometry. Previous/current share camera and display scale; reference aspect is preserved. Inspect panel volume, attachments and lower surfaces as well as the outline.

damage.note: Left to right: intact; door_FL and door_RL loose; front and back loose; wheel_FL cambered; front, door_FL and wheel_FL detached; a stripped shell. Detached parts persist as dynamic debris, so the lying parts are the debris they leave.

paints.pattern: Seat colour on the paint key, the number on the roof (anchor roof_number) and in the HUD badge; tyres stay dark, glass and lamps keep their colour. Full-tier patterns (plan section 2.3) are not drawn yet.
